parameters.content:
## SLA Breach Escalation Pack
An agentic n8n workflow that turns an SLA breach into a **complete escalation pack** and gets it to the right people, with a human gate on anything customer-facing.

**Start here**
1. Open node **Config** and set your values (all optional for the mock demo).
2. **Activate** the workflow.
3. Open `/webhook/mock-helpdesk?op=console` on your n8n host and click *Run breach scan*.

## A. Detector
Polls the helpdesk every 5 minutes, skips paused, closed and already-escalated tickets, and fires **one escalation execution per breach** so each ticket can wait for its own approval.

## B. Understand and draft
1. **Collect details** (ticket, customer, SLA, thread)
2. **Policy** scores severity and picks the level (rules, not LLM)
3. **Baseline pack** (always valid)
4. **LLM** drafts, then a **second LLM call reviews** the customer message
5. **Compose** runs a deterministic guardrail on the final text

## C. Act and close the loop
Internal actions run immediately (private note, tag, Slack). The **customer reply waits for human approval** (form link, 30 min timeout). Every outcome is written back to the ticket as an audit note.

## Mock helpdesk (demo target)
Freshdesk v2-shaped API and a console UI served by n8n, so the demo needs no paid trial. To use real Freshdesk: set `helpdesk_mode` to `freshdesk`, base URL to `https://YOURDOMAIN.freshdesk.com/api/v2`, add the API key, then delete this block.
